svg.title: 3. Event time, watermarks and late data
svg.text: Event time (when the courier app captured the event)
- Dashboards get a number within ~35 s of the minute closing,
and it corrects itself for 2 more minutes.
- Upserts by a deterministic id make re-fires and job restarts
idempotent: no double counting in OpenSearch.
- Nothing is dropped. Data later than 2 min is rare (0.3% here),
so it is fixed in batch instead of holding state for hours.
Late data in a 1-minute per-zone window: what fires when, and where stragglers go
e2 event_time 12:00:45, arrives between A and B
(courier in a tunnel, app flushed late)
→ W re-fires with a corrected count
→ goes to the late-data side output
Watermark = newest event time seen - 30 s. withIdleness(1 min) stops a quiet shard from holding it back.
lake stays the system of record
